import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from os import listdir

print(listdir("data"))

flights = pd.read_csv("data/flights.csv")
sns.relplot(
  data = flights,
  x = "year",
  y = "passengers"
)
plt.show()
